# OpenCollar Edge fixtures

`uplinks.jsonl`: one uplink per line with `f_port`, `data_hex` and the values the public decoder produces. Source: Smart Parks wiki, https://wiki.smartparks.org/devices/opencollar/lorawan_messages (fetched 2026-09-03), recorded on a RangerEdge hardware 1.4 with firmware 4.4 near Utrecht on 2023-11-30. The flash log example is the same page's port 29 example. Recorded uplinks from live collars are added here with a note of their origin as they come in.

`docs/devices/opencollar-protocol-research.md` holds the full protocol study these fixtures come from.
